content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire and life safety contracting and building services; it does not make pre-insulated piping for energy or industrial projects."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders; a different product set and customer base."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Water meters and flow instruments for utilities; measurement products rather than insulated piping systems."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Wellheads and pressure control for oil wells; well-site equipment and services, not piping systems."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Aerospace components, valves and pumps plus composite panels; diversified and not insulated piping."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Utility smart meters, test equipment, filtration and aerospace parts; different products and customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing and industrial distributor; it resells products made by others rather than manufacturing engineered piping."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors; shares industrial customers but not pre-insulated piping."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Coatings, sealants and roofing for consumers and contractors; a different product and customer mix."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments; building systems rather than insulated piping."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Pumps only, sold to water, fire and industrial buyers; equipment rather than insulated piping systems."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Heat tracing and insulation products with engineering and installation for oil, gas and process plants, sold to the same project buyers."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures, water coolers and filters for buildings; different products and customers."}]}
